formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets the owner's USDt allowance for `spender` to exactly `value`, replacing any earlier allowance (TetherToken.sol ERC20PermitUpgradeable.permit -> _approve: `_allowances[owner][spender] = amount`).
The signature can be used up to `deadline` (`require(block.timestamp <= deadline)`).
Uses up the owner's current permit nonce (_useNonce), so any other permit signed with that nonce stops working.
formats.shown: "Authorize spending of tokens", with the spender as a raw address, the maximum amount in USDt (shown as "Unlimited" at or above 2^255), a valid-until date, and the owner.

findings.title: Permit has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line names neither the token, amount nor spender.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats Permit: "intent": "Authorize spending of tokens", and there is no interpolatedIntent. Case 0 screen intent is only "Authorize spending of tokens". The amount (2500 USDt) and the spender are only in the fields.
findings.fix: Add "interpolatedIntent": "Allow {spender} to spend up to {value} until {deadline}".
